picks.title: What Will Live Because You Lived? | Rabbi Bernath's Sermon for Neilah 2026

picks.title: Who is the Jewish Messiah? With Rabbi Ken Spiro

picks.title: The Teshuvah Shmuz 324: A Diamond with a Flaw
picks.summary:
Yom Kippur forces us to confront the things we've done wrong. But how do you honestly admit your failures without allowing them to define you? Rabbi Shafier reveals the crucial difference between being flawed and being a failure, and why even the greatest people in history made mistakes. Through the powerful image of a diamond with a flaw, discover how to face your shortcomings without denying them or being crushed by them, do real teshuvah, and keep moving forward toward the person you're capable of becoming.

picks.title: Succos - When You Find Yourself, There’s Room for Everyone
picks.summary: Why is it sometimes so difficult to make room for someone who is different from us? Given to NCSY 4G advisors as part of their chinuch development, in this shiur Rav Burg explores how returning to ourselves on Yom Kippur prepares us to welcome others into our sukkah.Through Rav Kook’s understanding of teshuvah, the arba minim, and the story of the Baal Shem Tov’s sukkah, we explore what allows an advisor to see beyond a teenager’s struggles and build a relationship in which she feels she genuinely belongs.
